name: tinyBenchmarks
description: tinyBenchmarks is a suite of reduced-size versions of popular LLM evaluation benchmarks designed to reliably estimate model performance with significantly fewer examples, reducing evaluation cost while maintaining accuracy.
reputation: A relatively new but well-regarded benchmark suite that has gained attention for offering cheap, fast proxies for standard LLM evals.
notes: Includes tiny versions of Open LLM Leaderboard, MMLU, HELM, and AlpacaEval 2.0; focuses on reducing evaluation examples while preserving reliability.
